Markup guidance is policy-compliant: schema values only from visible content or user facts with labelled placeholders (SKILL.md:86), aggregateRating/review only for genuine visible reviews (schema-templates.md:11,70,92,191; validation-guide.md:40), and no keyword stuffing or misleading clickbait (meta-tag-formulas.md:100).
